metadata.title: fix(ui): A2A agent list now refreshes correctly after deletion
metadata.author: rakdutta

description:
The A2A agent list was not refreshing properly after deleting an agent. The UI was attempting to refresh using a hardcoded path pattern (${type}/partial) and target selector (#${type}-table), which didn't match the actual A2A agent panel     
  configuration (a2a/partial path and #agents-table target).                                                                                                                                                                                        
   
  Root cause: The refresh logic in formHandlers.js used string interpolation instead of consulting the centralized PANEL_SEARCH_CONFIG, causing mismatches for any entity type whose path/selector didn't follow the assumed pattern.               
                             
  Solution                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
                             
  Refactored handleToggleSubmit in formHandlers.js to use PANEL_SEARCH_CONFIG as the single source of truth for partial URLs and target selectors. This ensures correct refresh behavior for all panel types.                                       
   
  Changes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                             
  - mcpgateway/admin_ui/constants.js:                                                                                                                                                                                                               
    - Added servers entry to PANEL_SEARCH_CONFIG (was missing, causing potential refresh issues for virtual servers)
    - Added documentation warning that all entity types used with delete/toggle operations must be registered                                                                                                                                       
  - mcpgateway/admin_ui/formHandlers.js:                                                                                                                                                                                                            
    - Renamed handleToggleSubmit → handleFormSubmitAndRefresh (kept legacy alias for compatibility)                                                                                                                                                 
    - Use PANEL_SEARCH_CONFIG to retrieve partialPath and targetSelector instead of hardcoded patterns                                                                                                                                              
    - Added ENTITY_DISPLAY_NAMES map for better confirmation dialog messages (singular names)                                                                                                                                                       
    - Added validation that throws descriptive error if entity type not registered in config                                                                                                                                                        
    - Enhanced refresh to preserve search query, tag filters, and pagination state                                                                                                                                                                  
  - tests/unit/js/formHandlers.test.js:                                                                                                                                                                                                             
    - Added test verifying A2A agents use correct a2a/partial path and #agents-table selector                                                                                                                                                       
    - Added test verifying catalog/servers use correct servers/partial path and #servers-table selector                                                                                                                                             
    - Added test verifying error thrown when PANEL_SEARCH_CONFIG missing for a type                                                                                                                                                                 
    - Updated existing tests to use plural entity type keys (aligns with config)                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  Testing                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  - ✅ Unit tests pass (4 new test cases)                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  - ✅ Manual verification: A2A agent deletion now refreshes list immediately
  - ✅ Manual verification: Server deletion refreshes correctly                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  Closes #4247

reviews.author: marekdano
reviews.body:
### Summary

  The PR correctly fixes the root cause: the old `handleToggleSubmit` used `${type}-table` and `${type}/partial` via string interpolation, which broke for A2A agents since `"a2a-agents"` doesn't map to `#a2a-agents-table` (actual: `#agents-table`) or `a2a-agents/partial` (actual:`a2a/partial`). Routing through `PANEL_SEARCH_CONFIG` is the right approach.

###  What's good

  - Core fix is correct — `PANEL_SEARCH_CONFIG["a2a-agents"]` already had the right `partialPath` and `targetSelector`; using it as the source of truth eliminates the mismatch.
  - Tests are meaningful — the new cases directly verify HTMX is called with the correct path and selector.
  - `buildTableUrl` integration preserves pagination/search/filter state across deletes, a nice improvement over the original.
  - Backward compatibility via export `const handleToggleSubmit = handleFormSubmitAndRefresh` is clean.
  - Validation error thrown for unregistered types sits outside the try-catch, so it surfaces loudly during development.

LGTM 🚀

commits.message:
fix(ui): address council review findings for A2A agent delete refresh

- Add fallbackOnly flag to roots PANEL_SEARCH_CONFIG to prevent HTMX
  from hitting non-existent /partial endpoint
- Check fetch response status before proceeding to refresh; treat
  status 0 as success for opaque redirect responses
- Move PANEL_SEARCH_CONFIG validation inside try/catch for graceful
  alert + navigateAdmin fallback on missing config
- Guard document.getElementById against null search/tag input IDs
- Add roots display name to ENTITY_DISPLAY_NAMES
- Preserve search/tag state in catch block fallback navigation
- Improve test cleanup: delete global mocks in afterEach, mock
  navigateAdmin for reliable assertions
- Add tests for roots fallbackOnly, fetch failure, opaque redirect
  (status 0), and missing config graceful fallback

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer

commits.message:
test(ui): fix vitest failures in formHandlers tests

Replace delete global.fetch / delete global.alert in afterEach with
safe default mocks. This fixes:
- vi.spyOn(global, 'fetch') failing when fetch was deleted
- expect(global.alert) failing when alert was deleted
- Unhandled ReferenceError when catch block calls alert()
